results.name: General Store
results.description: (Basic) Sells basic supplies, groceries, and various odds and ends.

results.name: Tailor
results.description: (Basic) Makes and sells clothing, including hats and cloaks. Also sells general items made from cloth, such as blankets, and carries out repairs and alterations of cloth goods.

results.name: Thatcher
results.description: (Basic) Builds roofs using layers of dried straw, reeds, rushes, etc.

results.name: Weaver
results.description: (Basic) Weaves raw fabric and baskets.

results.name: Alchemist
results.description: (Specialty) Brews and sells potions, as well as mundane herbs and alchemical ingredients.

results.name: Bank & Exchange
results.description: (Specialty) Encompasses auctions, banking, and the specific selling of gems or exchange of currency.

results.name: Rare Botanicals
results.description: (Exotic) Cultivates and sells herbs rare to the region.

results.name: Luxury Furnishings
results.description: (Exotic) Procures and sells all manner of home items for fine living, including furniture, art, and other high-quality goods.

results.name: Rare Libations & Fare
results.description: (Exotic) Sells (and, perhaps, makes or brews) drinks and/or food of surpassing quality or rarity to the region.

results.name: Rare Trade Goods
results.description: (Exotic) Procures and sells items and materials, such as ores or textiles, that are rare to the region.

results.name: Magic Shop - Books
results.description: (Exotic) Sells magical items with a focus on literature, arcane tomes and lore.

results.name: Doctor/Apothecary
results.description: Provides medical care.

results.name: Hired Help - Scholars & Clerics
results.description: Hired help, as the book names it here (Scholars & Clerics).

results.name: Archives/Library
results.description: (Non-commercial) A structure devoted to housing records and written information.

results.name: Academy/University
results.description: (Non-commercial) A conservatory devoted to the pursuit of higher knowledge, sometimes of a specific area of study.

results.name: Forum
results.description: (Non-commercial) A place designated for the use of intellectual debate and discussion.

results.name: Schoolhouse
results.description: (Non-commercial) An institution focused on educating children.

results.name: Gathering Hall
results.description: (Non-commercial) General, open-use building used for local activities, or where locals may simply socialize.
